::: {#def-monte-carlo-estimate}
#### Monte Carlo estimate

Given draws $\vparam^{(1)}, \ldots, \vparam^{(M)} \siid \p(\vparam \mid \vy)$
and a function $g$,
the **Monte Carlo estimate** of the posterior expectation $\E{g(\vparam) \mid \vy}$ is

$$
\frac{1}{M} \sumto{m}{M} g\paren{\vparam^{(m)}}.
$$
:::
